events.title: Steam Demo Fest Update + Release Date!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Welcome to everyone discovering Shadow Island: Part I during the Steam Demo Fest!For the occasion, the demo has received a new update with several improvements, fixes, and support for two new languages. events.title: Demo Launch: Quick Update & Survey
events.summary: Hey everyone,The demo has been live for a bit over a week now, and the numbers are honestly way higher than I expected. Over 10,000 downloads, a steady stream of people playing through, and the reception has been super positive.Thanks to everyone who jumped in and checked out the game!Quick Feedback SurveyI've set up a quick survey to gather your feedback on specific points of the demo so I can improve the final release. If you want to help shape the game, you can fill it out here: https://tally

events.title: The demo is now available!
events.summary: 📢 The demo is available!Hello everyone,After quite a bit of work, the game's demo is finally available for download on Steam!What's included:The complete introduction to the story and the first 4 days.A first look at the different girl routes.Side quests and secrets to discover.Your feedback is precious for the rest of development. Feel free to share your thoughts or report bugs on the Community Hub.Thank you for your support and have fun playing!
